title: AWS Lambda consumer for a self-managed Apache Kafka cluster with OAuth (Cognito) auth (Java)
description: Creates a Lambda function that consumes from a self-managed Apache Kafka cluster on EC2, secured with SASL/OAUTHBEARER using an Amazon Cognito User Pool.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern provisions a self-managed Apache Kafka cluster (3 brokers on 3 EC2 instances, KRaft mode) plus a 4th EC2 instance that acts as a Kafka client and SAM deployment host.
The Kafka brokers are configured for SASL/OAUTHBEARER authentication, validating JWT access tokens issued by an Amazon Cognito User Pool that is created by the CloudFormation template.
The Cognito admin username and password are supplied as CloudFormation parameters. The client instance exchanges them for a Cognito access token and uses it to create the topic and produce messages.

The SAM template defines a Java Lambda function with a self-managed Apache Kafka event source. Note: at publishing time, AWS Lambda self-managed Kafka event sources do not yet support SASL/OAUTHBEARER; the authentication SourceAccessConfiguration is scaffolded as a placeholder to be completed when support ships.
For detailed deployment instructions see the README.md
